payload.summary:
Duty crew on routine rounds onboard an anchored ship
heard voices from the paint store and immediately informed
the bridge. Fog horn sounded and port control notified.
Seeing the alerted crews, the persons escaped with stolen
ship’s stores in a small boat. Port control dispatched a patrol
boat to the vessel for investigation.
